purpose: Append-only log of Jessie's human verification outcomes. These records are knowledge only and should recommend, not apply, future rule changes.

decisions.decision_summary: For Deconstructing Data, the calendar event can start at live time when the description clearly tells guests to join StreamYard 15 minutes early and includes the live start time.
decisions.source_of_truth: Human verification of Google Calendar location and description.
decisions.operator_guidance: For this show, validate pre-show timing from the description and location, not only the event start time.
decisions.suggested_rule_update: For Deconstructing Data, treat a 4:00 PM ET calendar start as valid pre-show when the description confirms the livestream begins at 4:15 PM ET.

decisions.decision_summary: Nina was confirmed in HighLevel and missing from ww@reveting.com before Jessie manually added the Google Calendar event.
decisions.operator_guidance: Nina is good to go for now as a Known Calendar Ownership Exception / Needs Calendar Ownership Cleanup because Jessie created the invite on jessie@reveting.com.
decisions.suggested_rule_update: Classify HighLevel booking without ww@reveting.com event as Needs Human Verification unless near-term and no alternate calendar/manual confirmation is known.

decisions.decision_summary: Jeff Chen replaced Daniel Burrus as a last-minute WinsDay guest. The correct operator state is waiting on Jeff's topics before LinkedIn, calendar, and email work.
decisions.operator_guidance: Do not expect Jeff in HighLevel. Classify the episode as waiting on guest topics until topics arrive, then update calendar description, post LinkedIn event, and send/schedule guest emails.
decisions.suggested_rule_update: Support manually confirmed guests who bypass HighLevel, and recommend adding them to HighLevel later.

decisions.decision_summary: Tim Berney is confirmed active. HighLevel incorrectly showed cancellation context under PR rep Samantha, and Jessie updated HighLevel.
decisions.operator_guidance: Classify Tim as human-confirmed active. Do not treat him as stale/orphaned.
decisions.suggested_rule_update: If related PR/cancellation context exists, classify as Needs Human Verification unless a human-confirmed active exception exists.

decisions.decision_summary: Cherry Willow July guests require pitch/confirmation follow-up and should not be treated as clean active bookings until confirmed.
decisions.operator_guidance: Track guest confirmation and RSVP acceptance risk before treating episodes as ready.
decisions.suggested_rule_update: If this repeats, add a Cherry Willow guest-confirmation state to the SOP readiness model.

decisions.decision_summary: HighLevel bookings are intended source of truth, but operations can include email cancellations, PR bookings/cancellations, manually added replacement guests, direct Google Calendar guests, or events on Jessie's calendar.
decisions.operator_guidance: If HighLevel booking exists but no ww@reveting.com event exists, classify as Needs Human Verification unless near-term and no alternate calendar/manual confirmation is known.
decisions.suggested_rule_update: Add source-of-truth nuance so HighLevel/calendar mismatches are verification alerts before becoming automation actions.

decisions.decision_summary: Traci appears canceled in both Google Calendar and HighLevel for July 21, so the slot needs a new guest.
decisions.operator_guidance: Recommend Write PR pitch / find replacement guest.
decisions.suggested_rule_update: Add show_needs_guest_replacement alert for shows within 30 days without a confirmed active guest.

decisions.decision_summary: Buddy appears confirmed in Google Calendar but canceled in HighLevel, so a human needs to follow up.
decisions.operator_guidance: Classify as Needs Human Follow-Up until Google Calendar and HighLevel are reconciled.
decisions.suggested_rule_update: Add Needs Human Follow-Up state when Google Calendar and HighLevel disagree but the guest may still be valid.
